svg.title: Sign in with AgentBuff and the marketplace gate
svg.desc: 1. A new owner signs in through AgentBuff OIDC. 2. The gate checks at the door that the account owns the product, and marks the new store as gated. 3. Each request checks the owner's entitlement with a 10 minute cache and a one hour grace period if AgentBuff cannot be reached. 4. If access lapses the store answers 403 with a frozen code, the app shows why, and no data is changed. 5. After purchase, AgentBuff can request an MCP token with a signed assertion that lives at most a few minutes and can be used once.
